title: In-Distribution Forcing for Long Video Generation at Test Time
title_zh: 测试时长视频生成的分布内强制方法

paragraphs.en: Modern autoregressive (AR) video diffusion models excel at short-horizon video generation, yet generating long videos remains challenging due to drifting , where colors and textures shift, and motion dynamics decay. Existing works primarily rely on KV conditioning , which selects or modifies cached key-value (KV) entries to mitigate drifting. However, we observe that KV conditioning alone is insufficient as it assumes cached KV entries remain in-distribution. This assumption fails beyond the training horizon: nothing constrains the construction of KV entries during rollout, giving rise to the KV-provenance problem where cached entries themselves become out-of-distribution (OOD). To address this, we propose In-Distribution Forcing (ID-Forcing) , a test-time framework that aligns both KV caching and KV conditioning with training configurations. Its key mechanism, self-caching , prevents OOD KV entries at their source. Each chunk is cached without attending to prior KV entry, keeping the rolling window exactly in-distribution. Consequently, ID-Forcing seamlessly extends short-horizon models to minute-scale video generation. Extensive evaluations show that our method remains competitive on standard video generation benchmark while substantially outperforming prior work in mitigating drifting, as validated by both our drift metrics and a user study.

paragraphs.en: Recent advances in video diffusion models ( Google DeepMind, 2025 ; Kling Team, Kuaishou Technology, 2025 ; OpenAI, 2025 ; Wan et al., 2025 ) enable high-fidelity synthesis of short video clips with coherent motion, yet interactive applications such as world models ( Hong et al., 2025 ; Shen et al., 2026 ; Huang et al., 2025a ) , streaming content ( Kodaira et al., 2026 ; Henschel et al., 2025 ; Chen et al., 2025 ) , and long-form storytelling ( Elmoghany et al., 2026 ; Luo et al., 2026 ) demand generation far beyond a few seconds. To enable such long-horizon generation, autoregressive (AR) video diffusion ( Yin et al., 2025 ; Chen et al., 2024 ; Huang et al., 2025b ; Yang et al., 2026 ) has emerged as the standard paradigm, generating videos sequentially in chunks while conditioning each new chunk on the key–value (KV) cache of previously generated content. Specifically, Self-Forcing ( Huang et al., 2025b ) reduces the training-inference gap by training on autoregressive rollouts, while LongLive ( Yang et al., 2026 ) extends generation to longer horizons through streaming long-video tuning.
paragraphs.zh: 视频扩散模型的最新进展（Google DeepMind，2025；Kling Team，Kuaishou Technology，2025；OpenAI，2025；Wan 等，2025）使得能够生成具有连贯运动的高保真短视频片段，但交互式应用，例如世界模型（Hong 等，2025；Shen 等，2026；Huang 等，2025a）、流媒体内容（Kodaira 等，2026；Henschel 等，2025；Chen 等，2025）以及长形式叙事（Elmoghany 等，2026；Luo 等，2026），则需要生成远超几秒钟的内容。 为了实现这种长时程生成，自回归（AR）视频扩散模型（Yin 等，2025；Chen 等，2024；Huang 等，2025b；Yang 等，2026）已成为标准范式，它通过分块顺序生成视频，并在生成每个新片段时以先前生成内容的键值（KV）缓存为条件。 具体而言，Self-Forcing（Huang 等，2025b）通过在自回归展开上进行训练来缩小训练与推理之间的差距，而 LongLive（Yang 等，2026）则通过流式长视频调优将生成扩展到更长的时程。

paragraphs.en: However, the ability to generate over extended horizons does not ensure that visual quality persists. As generation proceeds, colors and textures tend to shift, and motion dynamics gradually decay. This progressive degradation, known as drifting , arises because the rollout at inference differs from the rollout seen during training. Training on self-rollouts ( Huang et al., 2025b ; Cui et al., 2026 ; Yang et al., 2026 ; Chen et al., 2026 ; Liu et al., 2026 ) addresses this by exposing the model to its own generated context, but only within a finite training horizon. Extrapolating beyond this horizon therefore introduces conditioning configurations outside the training distribution, causing errors to accumulate over time. Yet simply extending the training horizon cannot solve this issue, as extrapolating past the horizon is inherently unavoidable in arbitrarily long video generation.
paragraphs.zh: 然而，在更长的时间范围内生成内容的能力，并不保证视觉质量能够持续保持。 随着生成过程的推进，颜色和纹理往往会发生变化，而运动动态也会逐渐衰减。 这种渐进式的质量下降被称为“漂移”，其产生原因在于推理阶段的展开过程与训练阶段所见的展开过程存在差异。 在自展开数据上进行训练（Huang et al., 2025b；Cui et al., 2026；Yang et al., 2026；Chen et al., 2026；Liu et al., 2026）通过让模型接触自身生成的上下文来解决这一问题，但这仅限于有限的训练时间范围。 因此，超出这一范围进行外推会引入训练分布之外的条件配置，导致错误随时间不断累积。 然而，仅仅延长训练时间范围并不能解决这一问题，因为在任意长度的视频生成中，超出该范围进行外推是不可避免的本质特性。

paragraphs.en: To address drifting, a large body of work controls what the model reads from the KV cache during generation, which we refer to as KV conditioning . Existing approaches typically select cached entries at the chunk level, as with attention sinks ( Yi et al., 2026 ) , or modify their temporal positional embeddings ( Yesiltepe et al., 2026 ; Kim et al., 2026 ) . These methods, however, are valid only under the assumption that the cached KV entries are in-distribution, as they consider only which entries to attend to and where to position them. This assumption has not been explicitly examined, and nothing ensures that it holds. Thus, understanding drifting requires examining not only the KV entries read during generation, but also the context under which they were constructed.
paragraphs.zh: 为了解决漂移问题，大量研究在生成过程中控制了模型从 KV 缓存中读取的内容，我们将其称为 KV 条件化。 现有方法通常在块级别选择缓存条目，例如注意力汇（Yi et al., 2026），或者修改其时间位置嵌入（Yesiltepe et al., 2026；Kim et al., 2026）。 然而，这些方法仅在假设缓存的 KV 条目符合分布的前提下有效，因为它们只考虑了选择哪些条目进行关注以及将它们置于何处。 这一假设尚未得到明确检验，也没有任何机制能确保其成立。 因此，要理解漂移问题，不仅需要研究生成过程中读取的 KV 条目，还需要考察这些条目是在何种上下文中构建的。

paragraphs.en: We observe that whether a KV entry is in-distribution is determined by KV caching , the operation that computes and stores a KV entry for each generated chunk. A KV entry depends not only on its own chunk but also on the other KV entries it attends to during KV caching, i.e., its provenance . Beyond the training horizon, every chunk is cached under a provenance never seen during training, so the resulting KV entry is out-of-distribution. We term this the KV-provenance problem ( Fig. 2 ). Since provenance is fixed at KV caching, no KV conditioning policy can recover from it, and keeping extrapolation in-distribution requires controlling both KV caching and KV conditioning .

paragraphs.en: Motivated by this insight, we propose In-Distribution Forcing (ID-Forcing) , a test-time method that aligns both KV caching and KV conditioning with the KV context configurations encountered during training. For KV caching, we introduce self-caching . Beyond the training horizon, the earlier KV entries are cached attending only to themselves, while the later ones are cached autoregressively on top of them, which prevents any unseen provenance from being constructed (§ 3.1 ). For KV conditioning, we show that the first chunk must remain in the conditioning window for it to stay in-distribution, and that self-caching keeps the rolling window exactly in-distribution (§ 3.2 ). Every KV operation is thus one that training executed. As a result, our method yields a remarkably simple framework: a plain rolling window with one rule for each KV operation, extending a five-second model to minute-scale generation.

paragraphs.en: We characterize the KV-provenance problem as a source of drift in long-video extrapolation and establish the importance of keeping both KV caching and KV conditioning within the configurations encountered during training (§ 3.1 ).
paragraphs.zh: 我们将 KV-来源问题描述为长视频外推中漂移的一个根源，并论证了在训练期间遇到的配置中同时保持 KV 缓存和 KV 条件化的重要性（§ 3.1）。

paragraphs.en: We propose In-Distribution Forcing (ID-Forcing) , which introduces self-caching to control cache provenance and jointly aligns KV caching and KV conditioning with training (§ 3.1 , § 3.2 ).
paragraphs.zh: 我们提出了分布内强制（In-Distribution Forcing，ID-Forcing）方法，该方法引入了自缓存机制以控制缓存的来源，并同时将 KV 缓存与 KV 条件化对齐至训练过程（§ 3.1、§ 3.2）。

paragraphs.en: We demonstrate effective suppression of drift in minute-scale generation, preserving visual quality and temporal consistency while maintaining active motion (§ 4 ).

paragraphs.en: We propose In-Distribution Forcing (ID-Forcing) , a training-free framework that keeps test-time extrapolation within the training distribution. Prior works address drifting by modifying KV conditioning, treating drifting as a consequence of discarding informative past context ( Yi et al., 2026 ; Yesiltepe et al., 2026 ; Kim et al., 2026 ) . We instead view drifting as a deviation from the training distribution, and show that this deviation occurs not just in KV conditioning, but also in KV caching. ID-Forcing therefore introduces two-level control over KV operations: KV caching and KV conditioning.
paragraphs.zh: 我们提出了分布内强制（In-Distribution Forcing，ID-Forcing），这是一种无需训练的框架，能够将测试时的外推保持在训练分布范围内。 先前的研究通过修改 KV 条件化来应对漂移问题，将漂移视为丢弃了包含信息的过往上下文所导致的后果（Yi et al., 2026；Yesiltepe et al., 2026；Kim et al., 2026）。 我们则将从训练分布的偏离视为漂移的本质，并证明这种偏离不仅出现在 KV 条件化中，也存在于 KV 缓存中。 因此，ID-Forcing 对 KV 操作引入了双层控制：KV 缓存和 KV 条件化。

paragraphs.en: Bounded Window and Exact Rolling. We constrain our conditioning window to a length of L < N L<N , holding κ 0 \kappa_{0} at slot 0 0 and the L − 1 L{-}1 most recent KV entries in the remaining slots. Consequently, every temporal distance within the window matches a state observed during training.

paragraphs.en: Self-caching is what keeps this rolling window exactly in-distribution. During training, every cached KV entry coexists with its complete provenance set because the training window only appends entries without eviction. Under test-time rolling, however, eviction removes past context, leaving the remaining KV entries without their original provenance. By contrast, a self-cached KV entry possesses no external provenance to lose; thus, eviction leaves its representation strictly within the training distribution. The complete procedure of our method is summarized in Sec. 3.2 .
paragraphs.zh: 自我缓存正是让这种滚动窗口始终保持符合分布的关键。 在训练阶段，每个已缓存的 KV 条目都会与其完整的来源集共存，因为训练窗口只会追加条目而不会淘汰任何条目。 然而，在测试阶段的滚动过程中，淘汰机制会移除过往上下文，导致剩余的 KV 条目失去其原始来源。 相比之下，自我缓存的 KV 条目本身没有需要丢失的外部来源；因此，淘汰操作只会使其表示严格保留在训练分布范围内。 我们方法的完整流程在第 3.2 节中进行了总结。

paragraphs.en: We evaluate ID-Forcing on minute-scale video generation, extrapolating far beyond the training horizon on two base models, Self-Forcing ( Huang et al., 2025b ) and LongLive ( Yang et al., 2026 ) . In § 4.2 , we compare ID-Forcing with existing test-time KV conditioning methods on 120- and 240-second generation through quantitative metrics, qualitative comparisons, and a user study. In § 4.3 , we examine how each component of ID-Forcing; self-caching for KV caching, and the first-chunk sink and re-rotation for KV conditioning, contributes to suppressing drifting.
paragraphs.zh: 我们在分钟级视频生成任务上评估了 ID-Forcing，在两个基础模型 Self-Forcing（Huang 等人，2025b）和 LongLive（Yang 等人，2026）上实现了远超训练时间范围的生成。 在第 4.2 节中，我们通过定量指标、定性对比和用户研究，将 ID-Forcing 与现有的测试时 KV 条件化方法在 120 秒和 240 秒的生成任务中进行了比较。 在第 4.3 节中，我们分析了 ID-Forcing 的各个组成部分——用于 KV 缓存的自我缓存机制，以及用于 KV 条件化的首段吸收与重旋转机制——在抑制漂移方面各自发挥了怎样的作用。

paragraphs.en: Implementation Details. We implement our method on top of the Wan2.1-T2V-1.3B ( Wan et al., 2025 ) architecture and evaluate it across two base models: Self-Forcing ( Huang et al., 2025b ) and LongLive ( Yang et al., 2026 ) . We compare against prior test-time extrapolation methods for autoregressive video diffusion, Deep Forcing ( Yi et al., 2026 ) , ∞ \infty -RoPE ( Yesiltepe et al., 2026 ) , and MemRoPE ( Kim et al., 2026 ) . Each video chunk consists of 3 latent frames, generated using a 4-step denoising schedule at timesteps { 1000,750,500,250 } \{1000,750,500,250\} . We use conditioning window length L = 3 L=3 and self-caching length ℓ = 2 \ell=2 for Self-Forcing. For LongLive, which is trained on minute-long videos, we apply our method from the first chunk with L = 3 L=3 and ℓ = 3 \ell=3 . In both cases, ℓ \ell counts the sink κ 0 \kappa_{0} .

paragraphs.en: Quantitative Results. Tab. 1 reports VBench-Long ( Huang et al., 2024 ) metrics for 120- and 240-second videos, built on top of two base models. Compared with all baselines, ID-Forcing achieves substantial gains on both drift metrics, indicating that visual quality and motion dynamics remain stable over long durations. This resistance to motion degradation is further shown by Dynamic Degree, where our method achieves the highest score in every setting. In contrast, base models such as Self-Forcing and LongLive exhibit markedly lower dynamic degree, particularly at longer durations, reflecting a tendency toward frame freezing as generation extends.
paragraphs.zh: 定量结果。 表 1 报告了基于两种基础模型，在 120 秒和 240 秒视频上的 VBench-Long（Huang 等人，2024）指标。 与所有基线方法相比，ID-Forcing 在两项漂移指标上均取得了显著提升，表明视觉质量和运动动态在长时间段内保持稳定。 Dynamic Degree 进一步证明了这种对运动退化的抵抗能力：我们的方法在所有设置中都获得了最高分数。 相比之下，Self-Forcing 和 LongLive 等基础模型的动态程度明显较低，尤其是在更长的视频时长中，反映出随着生成时间延长，帧逐渐冻结的趋势。

paragraphs.en: Qualitative Results. Fig. 4 shows qualitative comparisons on 2-minute video generation. On the Self-Forcing base model, the base model itself suffers severe color and motion collapse over time. Adding Deep Forcing stabilizes color but subject consistency still degrades, with the puppies’ identities gradually drifting. ∞-RoPE exhibits color saturation alongside a similar loss of subject consistency, while MemRoPE shows unnatural color shifts and changing textures across frames. In contrast, ID-Forcing remains stable throughout, preserving both subject consistency and color fidelity.
paragraphs.zh: 定性结果。 图4展示了2分钟视频生成的定性对比。 在 Self-Forcing 基础模型中，该基础模型本身会随时间推移出现严重的颜色和运动崩溃问题。 加入 Deep Forcing 后颜色得以稳定，但主体一致性仍然下降，幼犬的身份逐渐模糊。∞-RoPE 出现了颜色饱和度提升以及类似主体一致性的丧失问题，而 MemRoPE 则表现出非自然的颜色偏移和跨帧变化的纹理。 相比之下，ID-Forcing 在整个过程中保持稳定，同时保留了主体一致性和颜色保真度。

paragraphs.en: User Study. We conducted a user study to complement our quantitative results. Following the 2AFC protocol used in prior works ( Yi et al., 2026 ; Kim et al., 2026 ) , we extend both the evaluation metrics and the number of prompts to specifically capture long-horizon degradation. 20 participants compared our method against 4 Self-Forcing-based baselines across 20 diverse prompts, each judging a single Baseline-vs-Ours pair per prompt across six dimensions: Color Consistency, Background Consistency, Subject Consistency, Dynamic Degree, Temporal Flickering, and Overall Preference (details in App. § C ). As shown in Tab. 2 , participants consistently preferred our method over all baselines across every evaluated dimension.
paragraphs.zh: 用户研究。 我们开展了一项用户研究，以补充我们的定量结果。 遵循先前研究（Yi et al., 2026；Kim et al., 2026）中使用的 2AFC 协议，我们扩展了评估指标和提示词数量，以专门捕捉长期退化问题。20 名参与者将我们的方法与 4 种基于自我强化的基线方法进行了比较，共涉及 20 个多样化的提示词。对于每个提示词，参与者需从六个维度对“基线方法 vs. 我们的方法”的成对结果进行判断：颜色一致性、背景一致性、主体一致性、动态程度、时间闪烁和整体偏好（详见附录 § C）。 如表 2 所示，在所有评估维度中，参与者始终更倾向于我们的方法。

paragraphs.en: We ablate the three components of ID-Forcing: self-caching for KV caching, and, for KV conditioning, retaining the first chunk as a sink and re-rotating the window into the trained positional range. As shown in Fig. 5 , without any of them, Self-Forcing drastically collapses beyond the training horizon. Retaining the first chunk largely stabilizes generation, consistent with the known empirical effect of attention sinks, but colors and textures still drift, frames flicker, and the video periodically resets to an earlier scene. Adding re-rotation improves this further, yet drifting persists, as KV caching remains out-of-distribution. Self-caching brings KV caching in-distribution as well, greatly reducing color and texture drifting while preserving the dynamics. Quantitative results are in Tab. 4 of App. § A .
paragraphs.zh: 我们对 ID-Forcing 的三个组件进行了消融研究：用于 KV 缓存的自我缓存，以及在 KV 条件化中保留第一个分块作为汇点，并将窗口重新旋转至训练时的位置范围。 如图 5 所示，若缺少其中任何一项，Self-Forcing 在超出训练范围后会急剧崩溃。 保留第一个分块能在很大程度上稳定生成过程，这与注意力汇点的已知经验效应一致，但颜色和纹理仍存在漂移，画面帧会闪烁，视频也会周期性地重置到更早的场景。 加入重新旋转操作后效果进一步改善，但漂移现象依然存在，因为 KV 缓存仍处于分布之外。 自我缓存也使 KV 缓存进入目标分布，从而大幅减少颜色和纹理的漂移，同时保留了动态变化。 定量结果见附录 § A 中的表 4。

paragraphs.en: Video Diffusion Models. Video diffusion models with bidirectional attention produce high-quality clips ( OpenAI, 2025 ; Wan et al., 2025 ; Kong et al., 2024 ; Yang et al., 2025 ) , but attend over the entire sequence at once, so their cost grows quadratically with length and the output length is fixed at sampling time. Autoregressive (AR) formulations instead factorize the video into chunks generated in sequence, each conditioned on the KV cache of its predecessors ( Chen et al., 2024 ; Yin et al., 2025 ; Huang et al., 2025b ) . This makes the cost linear, admits streaming output, and in principle allows a video of arbitrary length to be produced at test time. The AR factorization, however, feeds each chunk back as the condition for the next, so any deviation from the training distribution accumulates along the rollout, a failure known as drifting ( Chen et al., 2024 ; Huang et al., 2025b ) .
paragraphs.zh: 视频扩散模型。 采用双向注意力的视频扩散模型能够生成高质量的视频片段（OpenAI，2025；Wan 等，2025；Kong 等，2024；Yang 等，2025），但它们会一次性关注整个序列，因此其成本随序列长度呈二次方增长，且输出长度在采样时即被固定。 相反，自回归（AR）模型将视频分解为按顺序生成的多个片段，每个片段的生成都以先前片段的 KV 缓存为条件（Chen 等，2024；Yin 等，2025；Huang 等，2025b）。 这使得成本变为线性，支持流式输出，并且原则上允许在测试时生成任意长度的视频。 然而，这种自回归分解方式会将每个片段作为下一个片段的条件反馈回去，因此任何偏离训练分布的情况都会在生成过程中不断累积，这种失效被称为“漂移”（Chen 等，2024；Huang 等，2025b）。

paragraphs.en: Addressing Drifting in AR Video Diffusion. The most straightforward way is to train on longer contexts ( Cui et al., 2026 ; Liu et al., 2026 ; Yang et al., 2026 ; Chen et al., 2026 ; Lu et al., 2026 ; Chen et al., 2025 ; Teng et al., 2025 ) . However, this does not remove the boundary, since training always covers a fixed horizon while the AR formulation exists to continue past whatever length was trained. Moreover, this is infeasible with extremely long videos since the cost of extending that horizon during training grows with the target length. A test-time extrapolation method is therefore necessary regardless of how the model was trained, and the two directions are orthogonal: a better-trained backbone still requires a rule for what to do beyond its horizon.
paragraphs.zh: 解决 AR 视频扩散中的漂移问题。 最直接的方法是在更长的上下文中进行训练（Cui 等，2026；Liu 等，2026；Yang 等，2026；Chen 等，2026；Lu 等，2026；Chen 等，2025；Teng 等，2025）。 然而，这并未消除边界问题，因为训练始终覆盖一个固定的时间范围，而 AR 框架的存在正是为了能够延续到训练时长之外的任何长度。 此外，对于极长的视频而言，这种方法并不可行，因为在训练过程中扩展该时间范围的成本会随着目标长度的增加而增长。 因此，无论模型如何训练，都需要一种测试时的外推方法，且这两种方向相互独立：即使骨干网络训练得更好，仍然需要一套规则来决定如何处理超出其时间范围之外的内容。

paragraphs.en: Test-time methods approach this by managing the KV cache during generation. Deep Forcing ( Yi et al., 2026 ) keeps early KV entries as sinks, realigns their temporal RoPE to the current timeline, and compresses the rest. ∞ \infty -RoPE ( Yesiltepe et al., 2026 ) reassigns temporal indices so that the offsets seen at inference stay within the trained range. MemRoPE ( Kim et al., 2026 ) caches keys without rotation and aggregates evicted entries into memory tokens, applying RoPE online at attention time. All of these act on KV conditioning , leaving untouched how each KV entry was written. In contrast, we address both KV caching and KV conditioning , keeping test-time extrapolation within the training distribution.

paragraphs.en: In this paper, we introduce In-Distribution Forcing , a training-free framework designed to enable stable long-horizon video generation. By analyzing the autoregressive (AR) model’s key-value (KV) dynamics, we identify the KV-provenance problem : a critical out-of-distribution (OOD) failure mode originating at the caching level. To resolve this, we propose a two-level KV management rule: at the caching level, we apply self-caching for KV caching; at the conditioning level, we strictly bound the window length ( L ≤ N − 1 L\leq N{-}1 ) while permanently fixing the first chunk κ 0 \kappa_{0} . Extensive quantitative and qualitative evaluations demonstrate that our method achieves highly competitive performance across diverse durations, backbones, and metrics. Most importantly, our framework effectively addresses the quality drift issue inherent to autoregressive models, maintaining stable video dynamics even over minute-scale generations.

paragraphs.en: Color Drift (HSV Histogram). Following Xiang et al. (2026) , we quantify changes in color distribution over the course of a generated sequence by comparing the color histograms of the first and last frames. Given the initial frame and final frame of a generated video, we convert both to HSV space and compute an L 1 L_{1} -normalized histogram of the Hue channel using 180 bins, denoted h start , h end ∈ ℝ 180 h_{\text{start}},h_{\text{end}}\in\mathbb{R}^{180} , with ‖ h start ‖ 1 = ‖ h end ‖ 1 = 1 \|h_{\text{start}}\|_{1}=\|h_{\text{end}}\|_{1}=1 . We measure the L 1 L_{1} distance ‖ h start − h end ‖ 1 \|h_{\text{start}}-h_{\text{end}}\|_{1} between the two histograms, which lies in [ 0 , 2 ] [0,2] .
paragraphs.zh: 色彩漂移（HSV 直方图）。遵循 Xiang 等人（2026）的方法，我们通过比较生成序列中第一帧和最后一帧的色彩直方图，来量化色彩分布在整个生成过程中的变化。给定生成视频的初始帧和最终帧，我们将两者都转换为 HSV 空间，并使用 180 个分箱计算色相通道的 L₁ 归一化直方图，表示为 h_start, h_end ∈ ℝ¹⁸⁰，其中 ‖h_start‖₁ = ‖h_end‖₁ = 1。我们测量两个直方图之间的 L₁ 距离 ‖h_start − h_end‖₁，其取值范围在 [0, 2] 内。

paragraphs.en: Motion Drift (Dynamic Degree Difference). To measure how well motion is sustained throughout a generated sequence, we compute the Dynamic Degree ( Huang et al., 2024 ) separately over the first 5 seconds and the last 5 seconds of the video, denoted d start d_{\text{start}} and d end d_{\text{end}} , respectively. We measure the difference | d start − d end | |d_{\text{start}}-d_{\text{end}}| , which lies in [ 0 , 1 ] [0,1] and captures the extent to which motion established early in the video is preserved or lost by the end of generation. A large difference reflects degradation, most commonly a collapse toward static, near-frozen frames.
paragraphs.zh: 运动漂移（动态程度差异）。 为了衡量生成的序列中运动保持得有多好，我们分别对视频的前 5 秒和后 5 秒计算动态程度（Huang 等，2024），分别表示为 d start d_{\text{start}} 和 d end d_{\text{end}}。 我们测量差异 | d start − d end | |d_{\text{start}}-d_{\text{end}}|，其值位于 [ 0 , 1 ] [0,1] 之间，反映了视频早期建立的运动在生成结束时被保留或丢失的程度。 较大的差异表明存在退化，最常见的情况是画面退化为静态的、近乎冻结的帧。

paragraphs.en: To ensure fair comparisons across all baselines, we employed a balanced Latin-square design for baseline assignment. We divided the 20 prompts into 5 groups of 4 and split participants into 4 groups. Within each group of 4 prompts, we rotated the baseline assignment so that each of the 4 baselines appeared exactly once. As a result, every participant saw each baseline exactly 5 times (5 groups × 1 time each), and every prompt was compared against all 4 baselines equally across the full set of participants. This ensured that no baseline was unfairly matched with easier or harder prompts, keeping all comparisons balanced.
paragraphs.zh: 为确保所有基线之间的比较公平，我们采用平衡拉丁方设计来分配基线。 我们将 20 个提示分为 5 组，每组 4 个，并将参与者分成 4 组。 在每组 4 个提示中，我们对基线分配进行了轮换，使得 4 种基线每种恰好出现一次。 因此，每位参与者都恰好看到每种基线 5 次（5 组 × 每次 1 次），并且所有提示在整个参与者群体中都与全部 4 种基线进行了均等的比较。 这确保了没有任何一种基线会与较简单或较难的提示不公平地匹配，从而保持了所有比较的平衡性。
